## Design note

The poster car. Rear-biased mid-engine weight, a screaming 8500 rpm V8 and the most grip in the roster make it the fastest thing through a corner, but low yaw inertia means it rotates instantly — lift mid-corner and the rear comes round. Glass-cannon economics: winning in it pays well, crashing it is ruinous.

## How this car breaks

Everything behind the cabin is sacrificial: the aluminium rear subframe carries the engine, gearbox and both rear suspension corners, so any rear or rear-quarter hit kills drive, and the side fuel tanks behind the seats make T-bones dangerous. The short front has almost no crumple length. Aluminium panels tear rather than dent. Durability class 1.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for 90s mid-engine 3.5 L V8 exotics
- published dyno sheets for flat-plane 3.5 V8s
- engineering tables (tire radius, ride frequency, opposed-piston caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 570 | 0.78 | 440 |
| pitch | 2227 | 0.75 | 1670 |
| yaw | 2483 | 0.75 | 1860 |

## Aerodynamics

Frontal area A = 0.82·W·H = 1.82 m²; Cd = 0.33 → **CdA = 0.602 m²**. Lift Cl·A front/rear = -0.05 / -0.12 m² (class-typical; positive = lift). No add-on aero (`aero_downforce_coeffs` = 0, mods add it).

## Engine

3.5 L DOHC 40-valve flat-plane V8, naturally aspirated, dry sump. Class-typical 90s exotic flat-plane V8 (~80 kW/L), torque peaking high and power at 8250 rpm, per published spec-class data and owner dynos.

| rpm | N·m | kW |

| 1000 | 180 | 18.8 |
| 2000 | 240 | 50.3 |
| 3000 | 285 | 89.5 |
| 3500 | 305 | 111.8 |
| 4000 | 320 | 134.0 |
| 4500 | 335 | 157.9 |
| 5000 | 348 | 182.2 |
| 5500 | 358 | 206.2 |
| 6000 | 363 | 228.1 |
| 6500 | 360 | 245.0 |
| 7000 | 352 | 258.0 |
| 7500 | 343 | 269.4 |
| 8000 | 330 | 276.5 |
| 8250 | 322 | 278.2 |
| 8800 | 280 | 258.0 |

Peak **278 kW @ 8250 rpm**, **363 N·m @ 6000 rpm**. Idle 1000 / redline 8500 / limiter 8800 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.12 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 10% of peak torque = 36 N·m. Power-to-weight 202 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

6-speed manual (open gate), clutch-type rear LSD. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 60 N·m, power ramp 0.50, coast ramp 0.35. Clutch capacity 1.40 × peak torque = 510 N·m. Shift time 0.22 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.08 | 13.24 | 79 |
| 2 | 2.16 | 9.29 | 112 |
| 3 | 1.61 | 6.92 | 150 |
| 4 | 1.27 | 5.46 | 190 |
| 5 | 1.03 | 4.43 | 235 |
| 6 | 0.84 | 3.61 | 288 |

Final drive 4.30, reverse 2.92. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.325 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.32 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 269 kg | 2.00 Hz | 42400 N/m | 2160 N·s/m | 3240 N·s/m | 0.12 m |
| Rear | 375 kg | 2.15 Hz | 68400 N/m | 3240 N·s/m | 4860 N·s/m | 0.13 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 1.6°/g with 50% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.307 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 148194 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 48383 F / 89185 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **11300 F / 0 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 1.5°/g, front share 45%. Bump stops 200000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -1.0° F / -1.8° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.25° R (+ = in), caster 7.5°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 330 mm disc, pistons per side 40 mm + 40 mm → A = 25.1 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 140 mm, pad μ = 0.45: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.45·100 bar·25.1 cm²·0.140 m = **3167 N·m**
- Rear: 310 mm disc, pistons per side 36 mm + 36 mm → A = 20.4 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 130 mm, pad μ = 0.42: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.42·100 bar·20.4 cm²·0.130 m = **2223 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1224 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.59×), rear needs 903 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.46×). `bias_front` = f + 0.9·h/L = 0.57 (ideal distribution at 0.9 g, clamped 0.55-0.78). Handbrake 1330 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 16.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 11.8 m → outer-front path radius 5.79 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.49 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.500 rad (28.6°)** (outer 25.0°, inner 33.3° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.50). Rack speed 1.6 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/lucciola_350.json`)

120 nodes, 704 beams, 3 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-box-lattice --id lucciola_350 --width 1.9 --length 4.25 --height 1.17 --wheelbase 2.45 --mass 275.0 --clearance 0.11` (20% of vehicle mass).
- Shaped top layer to the `mr` profile (hood/deck/bumper tops dropped to beltline, greenhouse narrowed to 86% width).
- Mid-engine: rows 2-3 between the rails relabelled FrameRear (engine bay behind the firewall); cabin is rows 4-6 only.
- Beams: pillars + roof rails → hss 3.0e-04 m² (26 beams).
- Beams: cabin cell → hss 3.5e-04 m² (64 beams).
- Beams: sills → hss 4.0e-04 m² (6 beams).
- Beams: crumple (outer) rail segments → hss 3.0e-04 m² (18 beams).
- Beams: inner rail segments / firewall → hss 4.0e-04 m² (18 beams).
- Beams: rear subframe / engine bay → aluminum 2.5e-4 m² (sacrificial) (54 beams).
- Beams: hood → aluminum 1.5e-4 m² (16 beams).
- Beams: outer panels → aluminum 2.0e-4 m² (286 beams).
- Components: engine + gearbox behind the cabin (rows 1-3), radiators and battery in the nose, side fuel tanks behind the seats; engine/gearbox fail early (0.12 / 0.08 m) — the rear is sacrificial.
- Detachables: FrontBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, RearBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, Hood 3500 N·s / 9 kg.
- Node mass: engine-mount nodes ×2.5, renormalised to 275 kg total.
